newsitem.title: USA: Washington Water Power still fixing lines.
newsitem.headline: Washington Water Power still fixing lines.

text.p: Washington Water Power Co was still working to repair power lines downed by an ice storm on Tuesday, the Spokane, Wash.-based company said Wednesday afternoon.
About 70,000 customers were still without power, down from 100,000 late Tuesday, company officials said during a teleconference call. The work is expected to take three or four more days.

WWP said the storm caused extensive and widespread damage to its electrical distribution systems. Outages had extended throughout the company's 30,000-square-mile service area in eastern Washington and northern Idaho.
Officials said the work was going slowly because foot patrols were needed to check distribution lines, and storm conditions were still disrupting service.
"We've got one feeder back up out of the 37 we had down to begin with," one WWP executive said.
